verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,

verses.text: both low and high, rich and poor alike.

segments.text: both low and high, rich and poor alike.

verses.text: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.

segments.text: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.

verses.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:

segments.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:

verses.text: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?

segments.text: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?

verses.text: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.

segments.text: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.

verses.text: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.

segments.text: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.

verses.text: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,

segments.text: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,

verses.text: that he should live on forever and not see decay.

segments.text: that he should live on forever and not see decay.

verses.text: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.

segments.text: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.

verses.text: Their graves are their eternal homes—their dwellings for endless generations—even though their lands were their namesakes.

segments.text: Their graves are their eternal homes—their dwellings for endless generations—even though their lands were their namesakes.

verses.text: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.

segments.text: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.text: This is the fate of the foolish and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah

segments.text: This is the fate of the foolish and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah

verses.text: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.

segments.text: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.

verses.text: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah

segments.text: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah

verses.text: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.

segments.text: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.

verses.text: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.

segments.text: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.

verses.text: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul—and men praise you when you prosper—

segments.text: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul—and men praise you when you prosper—

verses.text: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.
